column4: the census est_changed_lines (14) is the crate's delta, not the class size; the real donor file is 20 lines, read from the main path blob before planning the leaf

a protected owner with an overlapping API (M3IntArrayDeque: addFirst/addLast/peek/remove) is ALREADY only when the contract is the same; growth versus bounded refusal (offer* false, isFull, arbitrary capacity) is a different contract, so the leaf lands beside it and the protected file gets an NEC row, never an edit
column5: M3IntArrayDeque.addLast grows via ensure(); M3IntRingBuffer.offerLast returns false when full

column4: a reflective sequence dump costs ~0.5 ms per operation sequence on the JIT but ~150 ms under -Xint, so the -Xint pass replays 400 of the 6,000 sequences to stay under the 120 s bound

a brute-force reference model that shares no code with the donor oracle (plain int array shifted by System.arraycopy instead of ArrayDeque) makes the reference gate independent of the oracle the donor wrote
